SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Sorry for showing up like this all of a sudden...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 突然找过来吓到你了吧..
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 急に来ちゃって、びっくりしましたよね…
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Desculpa por ter vindo sem avisar, devo ter te assustado…
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Perdón por viniste sin avisar, seguro te asusté…
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: ببخشید که یکدفعه اینجوری ظاهر شدم...

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 아니 그건 괜찮은데... 설마 그 기사 때문에 온 거예요?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: No, it’s okay. But... did you come because of that article?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 那倒不是...你该不会是因为那个新闻才来的吧？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 那倒是還好…你該不會是因為那個新聞才來的吧？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: いや、それはいいけど…まさか、あの記事のせいで来たんですか？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Nggak apa-apa. Tapi... kamu datang gara-gara artikel itu, ya?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Não, isso não importa… mas, você veio por causa da matéria?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: No, eso no importa… pero, ¿viniste por lo del artículo?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: نه، اشکالی ندارد. اما... به خاطر اون مقاله آمدی؟

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 근데 오빠 저 기사처럼 그렇게 나쁜 짓 안 했잖아요...
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: But you didn’t do anything like what they’re saying.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 可是哥哥，我根本没像报道里说的做那么坏的事啊...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 可是哥哥，我根本不像報導裡那樣做壞事啊…
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: でもお兄さん、あの記事みたいな悪いことなんてしてないですよね…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Tapi kamu kan nggak ngelakuin hal-hal yang mereka bilang.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Mas você sabe que eu não fiz nada do que estão dizendo…
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Pero tú sabes que yo no hice nada de lo que dicen…
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اما شما کاری شبیه آنچه اونا می گویند انجام ندادید.

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 근데 누가 찍은 건지 사진은 여기저기 퍼져있고
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Still, somehow those photos are everywhere,
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 但不知道是谁拍的照片到处流传
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 不知道是誰拍照片，傳得到處都是
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: なのに誰が撮ったのか、写真があちこちに広まってて、
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Tetap aja, entah gimana foto-foto itu nyebar ke mana-mana,
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Não sei quem tirou aquelas fotos, mas elas já se espalharam por todo lado.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: No sé quién tomó esas fotos, pero ya se esparcieron por todos lados.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: با این حال، به نوعی اون عکس ها همه جا هستند،

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: And I’m being called some kind of “spoiled celeb” now.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 我现在成了全民公敌的“霸凌女”
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 我突然就變成大家口中的「國民霸凌女」了…
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 私、突然全国的に“パワハラ女”みたいになってるし
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Dan sekarang aku malah dibilang “anak seleb manja” segala.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: De repente me convirtieron en una "bully"
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: و اکنون به من نوعی "معروف خراب" می گویند.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: There are people swarming outside my place...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 连宿舍门口都挤满了人...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 住的地方外面也擠滿了人…
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 宿の前にも人がいっぱいで…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Orang-orang pada ngumpul di depan rumahku...
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: e tem um monte de gente na frente do meu hotel…
SCRIPT.SPANISH: y hay un montón de gente frente a mi hotel…
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: بیرون از خونه من مردمی هستند...

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: What am I supposed to do now?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 私、もうどうしたらいいんですか…
